cohort: The study included 571,321 pregnancies from women delivering within research sites of the NICHD Global Network for Women's and Children's Health Research Maternal Newborn Health Registry in six low and lower-middle income countries from 2010 through 2018.
finding: The study found an overall maternal mortality ratio of 157 per 100,000 live births across all sites, identifying several maternal and delivery characteristics associated with increased risk of death, and noted that all sites had an MMR higher than the Sustainable Development Goals target.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of maternal mortality.
